body: ViewerProps (packages/viewer-core/src/types.ts) is the single binding contract between every viewer (MDXViewer/JSONViewer/CSVViewer/SchemaViewer) and every host. Shape: {content, file:{id,name,ext,path?,sourceUrl?}, storage?, assets?, onNavigate?, trust?}. Do NOT add/change fields without bumping the contract and updating ALL viewers + both hosts together — host spreads props unwrapped, no adapter layer.
